headline: How much longer am I going to wait on this connection?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The pictures were hidden, yet your hand found the one ready to act.
Every tool is out, and both hands are occupied.
You asked how much longer you will wait on this connection. The readiness for action is what catches me.
You are still waiting on the connection, and you're asking how much longer.
The thing that has hold of the connection keeps action from becoming an answer. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the connection…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You reached without seeing him and chose the card made still by one rope.
One rope holds one ankle. The rest of him hangs loose.
You asked for the length of the waiting. This card brings me to the single rope.
Still, the connection remains suspended, and the waiting belongs to your question.
At the point where suspension would become a decision, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what's standing there…
c: You turned the Fool. The backs were identical, but your hand went to the one travelling light.
The small bundle on his stick is all he is carrying.
You asked how much longer you wait. The light bundle holds my eye.
But you're still waiting on the connection, and you're asking how long that continues.
Something stands between the open road and the connection. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
